# The Glam by Sandane Homes

> Boutique hotel in Ansal Golf Link-1, Greater Noida — near India Expo Centre & Mart, Pari Chowk and Knowledge Park.

The Glam by Sandane Homes is a boutique hotel at Plot No. AE-189, Block A, Ansal Golf Link-1, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201315, India. It is ideally located near India Expo Centre & Mart (~1.5 km walk / ~2.5 km drive), the Knowledge Park II Metro Station (~1.6 km) and Pari Chowk (~3–4 km).

## Key facts

- Name: The Glam by Sandane Homes
- Property type: Boutique hotel
- Rooms: 22
- Rating: 4.8/5 from 71 Google reviews
- Check-in: 2:00 PM
- Check-out: 12:00 PM
- Telephone: +91 8796321915

- Address: Plot No. AE-189, Block A, Ansal Golf Link-1, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201315, India
